title: Requirement Parsing
description: Requirement Parsing is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Parses plain-language requirements into structured items. Sentences are classified as functional, non-functional, or constraint and normalized. It takes text and produces items. Tunable parameters: per sentence. Guarantee: no requirement is ever dropped silently.

fields.mechanism: Sentences are classified as functional, non-functional, or constraint and normalized.
fields.guarantees: no requirement is ever dropped silently

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Clause Generation
description: Clause Generation is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Expands each requirement into testable specification clauses. Each item becomes shall-statements with acceptance criteria attached. It takes items and produces clauses. Tunable parameters: per item. Guarantee: clauses are always testable.

fields.mechanism: Each item becomes shall-statements with acceptance criteria attached.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Traceability Matrix
description: Traceability Matrix is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Links every clause back to its source requirement. The matrix maps requirements to clauses to tests; gaps are highlighted. It takes requirements, clauses and produces matrix. Tunable parameters: full. Guarantee: unlinked clauses are always flagged.

fields.mechanism: The matrix maps requirements to clauses to tests; gaps are highlighted.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Consistency Checking
description: Consistency Checking is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Finds contradictions between clauses automatically. Clauses are compared pairwise for conflicts in terms and numbers. It takes clauses and produces conflicts. Tunable parameters: pairwise. Guarantee: conflicts always cite both clauses.

fields.mechanism: Clauses are compared pairwise for conflicts in terms and numbers.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Completeness Scoring
description: Completeness Scoring is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Scores how completely the spec covers the requirements. Each requirement needs at least one clause; coverage is the scored ratio. It takes requirements, clauses and produces score. Tunable parameters: 0–100. Guarantee: uncovered requirements always list.

fields.mechanism: Each requirement needs at least one clause; coverage is the scored ratio.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Glossary Building
description: Glossary Building is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Builds a glossary of terms used across the spec. Terms are extracted and defined once; every use links to the definition. It takes clauses and produces glossary. Tunable parameters: per term. Guarantee: terms are never defined twice differently.

fields.mechanism: Terms are extracted and defined once; every use links to the definition.
fields.guarantees: terms are never defined twice differently

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Acceptance Criteria
description: Acceptance Criteria is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Attaches measurable acceptance criteria to every clause. Criteria state the measurement and the pass threshold. It takes clauses and produces criteria. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: criteria are always measurable.

fields.mechanism: Criteria state the measurement and the pass threshold.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Review Workflows
description: Review Workflows is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Routes the draft spec through reviewers with tracked comments. Reviewers comment per clause; each comment resolves or escalates. It takes draft and produces reviews. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: comments are never lost.

fields.mechanism: Reviewers comment per clause; each comment resolves or escalates.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Version Diffing
description: Version Diffing is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Shows what changed between spec versions clause by clause. Versions diff at the clause level with added, removed, and changed marks. It takes versions and produces diff. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: diffs never hide renumbering.

fields.mechanism: Versions diff at the clause level with added, removed, and changed marks.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Compliance Mapping
description: Compliance Mapping is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Maps spec clauses to external standards they satisfy. Standards' requirements link to clauses; uncovered standard items flag. It takes standards and produces mapping. Tunable parameters: per standard. Guarantee: mappings always show the evidence.

fields.mechanism: Standards' requirements link to clauses; uncovered standard items flag.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Risk Tagging
description: Risk Tagging is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Tags clauses with implementation risk levels. Risk factors — novelty, dependencies — score each clause low/medium/high. It takes clauses and produces risk tags. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: high-risk clauses always get mitigations.

fields.mechanism: Risk factors — novelty, dependencies — score each clause low/medium/high.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Effort Estimation
description: Effort Estimation is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Estimates implementation effort per clause. Historical data sizes each clause type; the total rolls up with confidence. It takes clauses and produces estimates. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: estimates always show their basis.

fields.mechanism: Historical data sizes each clause type; the total rolls up with confidence.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Export Formats
description: Export Formats is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Exports the spec as PDF, HTML, and structured JSON. All formats render from the same source; content is identical. It takes spec and produces exports. Tunable parameters: 3 formats. Guarantee: exports never diverge.

fields.mechanism: All formats render from the same source; content is identical.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Approval Signatures
description: Approval Signatures is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Collects signed approvals on the frozen spec. Approvers sign the spec hash; the signature record seals the version. It takes spec and produces signatures. Tunable parameters: per approver. Guarantee: signed specs are never editable.

fields.mechanism: Approvers sign the spec hash; the signature record seals the version.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Living Spec Sync
description: Living Spec Sync is a generation ability in the Automated Specification Synthesizers database. Keeps the spec in sync as requirements change. Changed requirements re-run the pipeline; affected clauses are marked for review. It takes changes and produces updated spec. Tunable parameters: incremental. Guarantee: syncs never silently drop clauses.

fields.mechanism: Changed requirements re-run the pipeline; affected clauses are marked for review.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
